layout.arrangement: A single white slide enclosed by a thin bright-red rectangular frame. Header row across the top: a small blue-outlined italic kicker box at top-left ('Example: Quadratic Kernel'), the large bold red title 'How to Kernelize SVM' centered, and a yellow circular badge with the slide number '36' at top-right. Below the header, a wide blue-outlined panel (upper panel) holds the original SVM dual objective on its first line, a row of two blue-outlined sub-boxes (W equation on the left, b equation on the right) on its second line, and a peach/orange-outlined 'Class of vector Z ⇒ sign(...)' strip beneath them (left-of-center, x approx. 13%-51%). In the vertical middle of the slide sits a narrow horizontal strip: a thin red-outlined rounded rectangle reading 'Kernelize using' on its left and, on its right, a second red-outlined box containing the red bold formula 'K(α,b) = α^T b^2'; a red-outlined white downward arrow hangs from this strip pointing into the lower panel. The lower blue-outlined panel mirrors the upper one: kernelized dual objective on line 1, the same W box on the left and the squared b box on the right on line 2, and a peach 'Class of vector Z is sign(...)' strip on line 3. A black video letterbox bar runs along the very bottom edge of the frame.
